Well, the site a few weeks ago had I'd say 4,000-5,000 active users. Then reddit went all ban hammer on a bunch of stuff and thousands of people moved here. This has lead to some growing pains as new servers are ordered etc.

If you are a programmer you can help out by addressing issues with voat and submitting the changes.

As a websites user base grows it needs increased processing capabilities from it's servers to deliver the content to more users. Considering the recent mass migration to voat, the user base expanded massively in a short time, thus the server scaling became a priority. During the mass migration the servers where essentially DDOS'd by the amount of users, the servers couldn't handle the amount of content requests, but Thanks to many generous users donating money and/or coding time, the performance of voat has been scaled up to the demand very well.
